3113185.findings: Two folded machine-woven rugs in red, navy and tan Persian-style pattern. No labels visible.

3113186.findings: Eight framed prints, all appear to be photomechanical reproductions (visible screen pattern) of colonial Tasmanian views: Tamar River, Low Head/The Nut style headland with sheep and emus, Hobart Town and Mt Wellington (two copies), Launceston township, a mill scene. Reproductions after Glover/Prout style colonial works, not original prints.
3113186.reason: Modern reproduction prints of colonial Tasmanian views.

3113188.findings: Unframed print of HRH The Prince of Wales (Edward VIII) in uniform with medal ribbons, framed coloured print of Princess Elizabeth in Girl Guide/ATS style cap, small card cut-out of His Majesty King Edward VII in Highland dress with envelope.

3113188.marks_read: His Royal Highness The Prince of Wales; His Majesty King Edward VII

3113189.findings: Six framed works: colour print of outback town cricket scene signed in pencil 'PRO HART' lower right margin (appears hand-signed in pencil, printing looks like etching or lithograph, no edition number seen); three Lionel Lindsay Giclee reproductions ('The Witch' wood engraving 1924, cat and magpie engraving, and 'King Billy' style etching portrait) each from an edition of 275 numbered and signed by publisher Robert C. Littlewood (one 131/275), not by Lindsay; gilt-framed kitten print.
3113189.reason: Pencil-signed Pro Hart print could be a genuine signed etching or lithograph; Lindsay pieces are publisher-signed giclee reproductions only.
3113189.marks_read: PRO HART (pencil); Robert Littlewood 131/275; National Library of Australia

3113190.findings: Oval framed watercolour portrait of a 1920s woman with marcel-waved hair and orchid corsage, signed 'Verna Edson'. Backing board is a reused architectural drawing ('Front Elevation', 'Detail at C'). Artist not known to have a market.
3113190.condition: Some foxing and staining to mount, frame wear.
3113190.reason: Decorative amateur watercolour by an unrecorded artist.

3113191.findings: Framed coloured Widdicombe Fair print with chorus text and copyright line, plus nine William Young (Widecombe) pottery character figures: Old Grey Mare, 'Arry 'Awke, Dan'l Widdon, Jan Stewer, Old Uncle Tom Cobley in his chair, Tom Pearse, Peter Gurney, Peter Davy, Bill Brewer, plus a standing Uncle Tom Cobley. 3113191.marks_read: Will Young Widecombe (base); figure names on bases
